groups.name: runway.demo.first-run
groups.description: Unattended install of a bundled demo site on first start (demo/evaluation deployments). Read by FirstRunDemoInstaller via @Value.

properties.name: runway.demo.first-run.id
properties.description: Id of the bundled demo site to install once, when the application is ready. Blank (the default) installs nothing. Skipped when a site with that id already exists, so a restart or upgrade never reinstalls it.

properties.name: runway.demo.first-run.host
properties.description: Host name to create the demo site with. Blank uses the demo descriptor's default host.

properties.name: runway.demo.first-run.master-username
properties.description: Login of the demo site's tenant superadmin.

properties.name: runway.demo.first-run.master-password
properties.description: Password of the demo site's tenant superadmin (hashed with Argon2id on install). Required when runway.demo.first-run.id is set; without it nothing is installed and a warning is logged. A secret: set it in the external application.yml.

properties.name: runway.endpoints.max-body-bytes
properties.description: Largest request body, in bytes, the kernel reads into a plugin endpoint's RouteRequest. A larger body is refused before the plugin runs. Default 10 MiB.

properties.name: runway.endpoints.max-form-bytes
properties.description: Largest application/x-www-form-urlencoded body, in bytes, the kernel reads for a POST or PUT plugin route before authentication and the CSRF check (413 above it). Kept small because any anonymous client can make the server buffer it; never above max-body-bytes, which still applies to other bodies. Default 256 KiB.

properties.name: runway.plugins.max-entry-bytes
properties.description: Per-entry decompression cap, in bytes, when installing an uploaded plugin archive (zip-bomb guard). Default 128 MiB, enough for a bundled library jar.

properties.name: runway.plugins.site-files.max-write-bytes
properties.description: Largest single write, in bytes, a plugin may make to its per-site subtree (sites/<id>/plugins/<pluginId>/) through the PluginSiteFiles service; also the largest file it may read whole. Default 16 MiB.

properties.name: runway.static-files.default-max-bytes
properties.description: Platform default storage ceiling, in bytes, for each site's files (sites/<id>/static/: Static files and Documents). An upload that would take the folder over it is refused; nothing stored is deleted. A site's own ceiling, set on Sites (platform.yml siteStorageCeilings), wins. 0 (the default) = unlimited.

properties.name: runway.plugins.root
properties.description: Folder the plugin loader discovers plugins in, read from the environment before the context starts. Blank (the default) means <runway.storage.external>/plugins. The console's plugin install, uninstall, enable and disable use the same folder.

properties.name: runway.storage.stats
properties.description: Removed before 1.0: it was never read (bandwidth is metered per site, in sites/<id>/stats/). Setting it has no effect; a startup warning names it.

deprecation.reason: Never had an effect; bandwidth is metered per site.

properties.name: runway.storage.logs
properties.description: Removed before 1.0: it only labelled a folder on the About page; the kernel writes no file there. Setting it has no effect; a startup warning names it.

deprecation.reason: Display-only; the kernel writes no file there.

properties.name: runway.node.name
properties.description: Human-friendly name of this node, shown on the About Runway page so a page or log line can be traced to one node behind a load balancer. Blank (the default) falls back to the OS host name. A value saved on the Platform settings page takes precedence.

properties.name: runway.console.hosts
properties.description: The host names the operator console (/__app, /app/login, /app/logout, /app/forgot-password, /app/reset) answers on, compared without case and without the port. Every other host gets a plain 404 for those paths. Empty (the default): the console answers on the default site's host names and on host names that serve no site (the server's IP address, localhost), but not on a host name that serves any other site. Set only in external/application.yml: a wrong value locks the console, and the file is the way back in. Read at startup; each node reads its own.
